[Hypothesis]

\(L\in\mathrm{FirstOrderLanguages}\) 及总字母表 \(\Sigma_L\) 见 17-df-first-order-language；\(\mathfrak A=(|\mathfrak A|,\mathcal I)\in\mathrm{Structure}(L)\) 见 17-df-structure。对每个 \(a\in|\mathfrak A|\)，令 \(c_a=\operatorname{Name}_L(a)\)，其中 \(\operatorname{Name}_L\) 是 17-df-language-constants 中已定义的规范新名字函数。\(L(C)\) 取 17-df-language-constants 的常元扩张，\(\upharpoonright L\) 取 17-df-reduct 的语言约化。原子公式集 \(\mathrm{AtomForm}_{L(\mathfrak A)}\)、句子集 \(\mathrm{Sent}_{L(\mathfrak A)}\) 与句子真值 \(\models\) 分别见 17-df-atomic-formula、17-df-sentence、17-df-sentence-truth。以下定义 \(C_{\mathfrak A}\)、\(L(\mathfrak A)\)、规范命名扩张 \(\mathfrak A_{\mathfrak A}\) 和 \(\operatorname{Diag}(\mathfrak A)\)。

[Assertion]

[Remark]

The diagram contains exactly the atomic and negated atomic \(L(\mathfrak{A})\)-sentences true in the canonical expansion that names every element of the carrier. Freshness makes the two interpretation graphs disjoint in domain, so their union is a function and the named expansion is uniquely determined.

math.tex:
\begin{aligned}
\quad
&C_{\mathfrak A}\coloneqq\{c_a:a\in|\mathfrak A|\},\qquad L(\mathfrak A)\coloneqq L(C_{\mathfrak A}),\\
&\mathfrak A_{\mathfrak A}\coloneqq
\bigl(|\mathfrak A|,\mathcal I\cup\{(c_a,a):a\in|\mathfrak A|\}\bigr),\\
&\mathfrak{A}_{\mathfrak{A}}\!\upharpoonright L=\mathfrak{A}
\quad\land\quad
\forall a\in|\mathfrak{A}|\;
c_a^{\mathfrak{A}_{\mathfrak{A}}}=a,\\
&\operatorname{Diag}(\mathfrak{A})
=
\bigl\{\sigma\in\mathrm{Sent}_{L(\mathfrak{A})}:
\bigl(
\sigma\in\mathrm{AtomForm}_{L(\mathfrak{A})}
\lor
\exists\alpha\in\mathrm{AtomForm}_{L(\mathfrak{A})}\;(\sigma=\neg\alpha)
\bigr)
\land
\mathfrak{A}_{\mathfrak{A}}\models\sigma
\bigr\}.
\end{aligned}
